_comment: 영웅·안내·적 음성 대사의 영어·베트남어 번역(tools/voice_i18n_src.py가 만든다). 소리 파일은 assets/audio/voice_<언어>/<id>_<상황>.ogg. 한국어 목소리 그대로 그 나라 말을 한다(사용자 결정 2026-11-17).

wukong.select: young, high and playful like a mischievous monkey

lubu.select: Who under heaven dares to stop me? Step forward, if you have the nerve.
lubu.idle: Hmph. My blood is restless. Where is the fight?
lubu.move: Out of my way! I'm coming through!
lubu.defend: Ha! Is that all you've got?
lubu.skill: Behold! The might of the peerless warrior!
lubu.win: Hahaha! No one under heaven can match me!
lubu.lose: Ugh... I will not forget this humiliation.

yisunsin.select: I still have twelve ships left.
yisunsin.idle: First, we must read the wind and the tides.
yisunsin.defend: Do not retreat. Hold the formation!
yisunsin.skill: Crane wing formation! Surround the enemy!
yisunsin.win: We won because we all fought together.
yisunsin.lose: Those who seek death shall live. I will rise again.

alexander.select: I will see the end of the world with my own eyes.
alexander.idle: There must be kingdoms beyond that horizon too.
alexander.attack: Clear the way before my sword!
alexander.win: Another land shall remember my name.
alexander.lose: Well done... I shall remember your name.

machao.select: The golden general of the west rides out!
machao.idle: My horse wants to run. So do I.
machao.attack: Take the spear of the west!
machao.defend: Is that all? I'll take it!
machao.skill: You won't escape! Chase them to the end!
machao.win: Ha! Victory to the western cavalry!
machao.lose: Not yet... It's not over yet!

eulji.select: I know these rivers better than anyone.
eulji.idle: Waiting for the enemy to tire is also strategy.
eulji.move: The time has come. Let us move.
eulji.defend: I will not give a single step.
eulji.skill: You fell for the trap! Break the dam!
eulji.win: Heh heh. Be content with this and go home.

leonidas.select: Not one step further shall you pass.
leonidas.idle: Polish your shields. The battle is near.
leonidas.skill: Do not retreat! We are the wall!
leonidas.win: Did you see? This is Sparta!
leonidas.lose: Even as I fall... I will not drop my shield.

hanxin.idle: A battle is won before it begins.
hanxin.skill: Fight with the river at our backs! There is no retreat!
hanxin.lose: My plan was shallow. I must rethink it.

ganning.select: Hear the bells? The great Gan Ning has arrived!
ganning.idle: Ugh, I'm itching for a fight!
ganning.win: Hahaha! The wine will taste great tonight!

choiyoung.select: Look upon gold as you would a stone.
choiyoung.idle: Only when the nation is at peace may a general rest.
choiyoung.skill: Raise an iron wall! Let no one through!
choiyoung.win: The people can sleep in peace tonight.

robinhood.select: Robin Hood, finest archer of Sherwood Forest.
robinhood.idle: Whose purse will be heavy today, I wonder?
robinhood.move: I know these woods. Follow me!
robinhood.attack: One arrow is all it takes!
robinhood.skill: I'll just borrow this. It's for the poor!

mulan.select: I will fight in my father's place.
mulan.idle: I'll polish my sword and wait for the moment.
mulan.skill: I'll rise again, as many times as it takes!
mulan.win: We did it! Is everyone safe?
mulan.lose: So frustrating... but next time, I'll win.

gyebaek.select: There is no going back. This is where we stand.
gyebaek.idle: The wind on the plains is cold.
gyebaek.move: Men of the last stand, forward.
gyebaek.attack: Strike with your lives on the line!
gyebaek.defend: I will not retreat until I die!
gyebaek.skill: Stand back! Come closer and I'll cut you down!
gyebaek.win: We held the line... again today.
gyebaek.lose: Is this the end... I fought without shame.

sejong.select: For my people, I will do anything.
sejong.idle: The night is deep. Just a little more reading.
sejong.attack: What is wrong must be set right!
sejong.defend: Do not rush. There is always a way.
sejong.skill: Write the voice of the people in letters of their own!
sejong.win: This is thanks to everyone's wisdom.
sejong.lose: I should have looked more carefully.

zhugeliang.select: The Sleeping Dragon has awakened. Shall I share my plan for the realm?
zhugeliang.move: The wind has changed. Let us go.
zhugeliang.attack: You are already in the palm of my hand.
zhugeliang.defend: I read that move long ago.
zhugeliang.skill: I shall deploy the Eight Trigrams. There is no way out.
zhugeliang.lose: Heaven is not on our side...

davinci.select: The world is full of wonders.
davinci.idle: How do birds fly... Hmm, I must draw it again.
davinci.move: Let's go and see for ourselves!
davinci.attack: What do you think of this design?
davinci.skill: Behold the blueprints in my mind!
davinci.win: Splendid! It worked just as I imagined!
davinci.lose: Hmm, I must revise the drawings.

zhouyu.select: The southeast wind is blowing. Our time has come.
zhouyu.idle: If the melody is wrong, I always notice.
zhouyu.move: Let us ride the river wind.
zhouyu.defend: You thought such a trick would fool me?
zhouyu.skill: Throw them into chaos! Shake their ranks!
zhouyu.win: Never underestimate Zhou Yu of Jiangdong.
zhouyu.lose: Why does heaven test me so...

jangyeongsil.select: Let me measure the time of the heavens.
jangyeongsil.idle: If I file this gear just a bit more...
jangyeongsil.attack: Behold the power of this device!
jangyeongsil.skill: Knowledge is power! The answer was in the books!
jangyeongsil.win: I did it! The water clock rings its bell!
jangyeongsil.lose: My calculation was wrong. I'll build it again.

archimedes.select: Eureka! I've found it, I've found it!
archimedes.idle: Don't step on my circles... I'm calculating.
archimedes.move: Give me a lever and I can go anywhere.
archimedes.attack: Take this! The power of principle!
archimedes.defend: You can't break through at that angle.
archimedes.skill: The principle of the iron wall! Force must scatter!
archimedes.lose: Heh, I set up the equation wrong.

sunwu.select: The best victory is won without fighting.
sunwu.idle: Know your enemy and yourself, and you will never be in peril.
sunwu.move: Let us move like flowing water.
sunwu.defend: Defend firmly and you will not waver.
sunwu.skill: All warfare is deception. The ruse worked!
sunwu.lose: I did not know my enemy well enough.

choichiwon.select: With a single line of writing, I will move the world.
choichiwon.idle: In the autumn wind, I chant in sorrow...
choichiwon.move: Shall I take up my brush and set out?
choichiwon.skill: The power of learning! Time to use what I know!
choichiwon.lose: Few in this world understand me.

libai.select: A cup beneath the moon, and a poem. What do you say?
libai.idle: Hmm... out of wine. But the moon is still bright.
libai.move: Let's go wherever the wind blows.
libai.attack: Swords and poems are best when drunk!
libai.defend: Oops! A drunk man is hard to hit.
libai.skill: Blow, O wind! Follow me, O clouds!
libai.win: Hahaha! Another cup for this feeling!

marcopolo.select: The East holds so many wonders.
marcopolo.idle: I remember the sunset over the Silk Road.
marcopolo.move: Let's set off to find a new road!
marcopolo.attack: Witness the skill of a seasoned traveler!
marcopolo.defend: Danger like this was common on the road.
marcopolo.skill: Navigate by the stars! Set the course!
marcopolo.win: I must write this story in my book!
marcopolo.lose: The way home is also a journey.

hypatia.select: Shall we read the paths of the stars together?
hypatia.idle: Never stop asking questions. That is learning.
hypatia.skill: Forget it all. Think again from the beginning.
hypatia.lose: There was still something I didn't know.

seohui.select: With words alone, I will defend this land.
seohui.idle: First, we must see what the other side wants.
seohui.attack: That makes no sense at all!
seohui.defend: Not an inch of land will I give up.
seohui.skill: Take heart! We are in the right!
seohui.win: We won without drawing a sword.

zeus.select: I am Zeus, king of thunder. Bow your head.
zeus.idle: No need to hurry. The heavens always wait.
zeus.attack: Face the judgment of the gods!
zeus.defend: You dare lay a hand on a god?
zeus.win: Heh heh heh. Was there ever any doubt?
zeus.lose: Impossible... I let my guard down.

wukong.select: Here comes the Great Sage, Sun Wukong!
wukong.idle: Yawn, I'm bored. Maybe I'll grab a peach.
wukong.defend: Hehe, that was just my clone!
wukong.skill: Let's go, cloud! A hundred thousand miles!
wukong.lose: Tch, don't tell my master, okay?

dangun.idle: Do you remember the day the heavens opened?
dangun.attack: Do not defy the will of heaven!
dangun.skill: Let light shine upon the whole world!
dangun.lose: This too must be the will of heaven.

athena.idle: Battles are won with the mind, not strength.
athena.attack: Take the spear of the goddess of war!
athena.skill: I grant you my protection. Fight without fear.
athena.lose: This time... you were one step ahead.

heracles.select: I finished twelve labors! Leave anything to me!
heracles.idle: Lion or monster, anyone out there?
heracles.skill: All-out attack! I'll smash a mountain!
heracles.win: Hahaha! The thirteenth labor is done!

gumiho.select: Oh my, falling for me already? Hehe.
gumiho.idle: Haaah... so bored. Anyone I can charm today?
gumiho.attack: Hehe, want a taste of my tails?
gumiho.skill: Shh... you'd better watch your back.
gumiho.win: Ahaha! Too easy! Wanna play again?
gumiho.lose: Hmph, I just went easy on you today. Really!

anubis.select: The scales of the underworld await you.
anubis.idle: The sand falls, and time is on my side.
anubis.move: Death is never in a hurry.
anubis.defend: The strength of the living cannot reach me.
anubis.skill: Tremble. The gates of the underworld open!
anubis.lose: Not yet... your time has not come.

dokkaebi.select: Gold, come out! Silver, come out! Bonk!
dokkaebi.idle: Anyone up for a wrestling match?
dokkaebi.move: Heh heh, where shall I go?
dokkaebi.win: Ha ha! Bring me buckwheat jelly!
dokkaebi.lose: Bah, I only lost because the sun came up!

haetae.select: I guard against fire and disaster.
haetae.idle: My horn tells right from wrong.
haetae.move: I go to guard the road.
haetae.skill: I hold! Disaster shall not take a single step inside!
haetae.win: The palace is safe once again.

perseus.select: I slew Medusa with my own hands.
perseus.idle: Sometimes you need a shield like a mirror.
perseus.defend: Look in my shield and I see everything!
perseus.skill: A keen blade! I can cut with my eyes closed!
perseus.win: The monster has fallen! Let's go home!
perseus.lose: Oh no... I met its gaze.

tengu.select: Every wind on this mountain is mine.
tengu.attack: Feel the wind of my fan!
tengu.defend: Hmph, you thought you could reach me?
tengu.skill: Charge! Strike like the mountain wind!
tengu.win: See? This is the master of the mountain.

isis.select: I give you the breath of life.
isis.idle: I can hear the waters of the Nile.
isis.defend: It's all right, I'll protect you.
isis.skill: A healing touch... let the wounds close.
isis.win: I'm so glad everyone is safe.
isis.lose: It's all right. We just rise again.

tesla.idle: Alternating current flows through my mind.
tesla.move: Let us move as fast as current.
tesla.skill: Lightning coil, activate! Behold the power of the sky!
tesla.lose: The world still cannot keep up with me.

nightingale.select: This lamp will never go out.
nightingale.idle: I should make my rounds of the ward tonight too.
nightingale.move: Let's go where the wounded are.
nightingale.defend: As long as I'm here, no one gives up!
nightingale.skill: Everyone, get up! We can still do this!
nightingale.lose: It hurts... but tomorrow I'll light the lamp again.

edison.select: Fail a thousand times, succeed once, and that's enough.
edison.idle: Not this filament. Bring me the next one.
edison.move: Come, let's step out of the lab!
edison.skill: Invention complete! The light is on!
edison.win: Ha, it worked on the thousand-and-first try!
edison.lose: I just found one more way that doesn't work.

wright.select: Today we will fly for sure!
wright.idle: Good wind... Brother, check the wings!
wright.defend: A little tilt and I can dodge it!
wright.skill: Exploration flight! We're up, we're up!
wright.lose: It's fine, I'll fix the wings and fly again.

amundsen.select: I survived the cold of the South Pole.
amundsen.idle: Preparation is victory. Let's check the sleds again.
amundsen.move: Step by step, to the very end.
amundsen.attack: Break the ice and push on!
amundsen.defend: I'm used to a blizzard or two.
amundsen.win: The flag is planted. We did it.
amundsen.lose: Coming home alive is part of exploring too.

verne.select: What you imagine will someday come true.
verne.idle: What lies twenty thousand leagues under the sea?
verne.move: Around the world in eighty days!
verne.skill: I read it in a book! The answer is in this chapter!
verne.win: A fine ending. Time to write the next volume.
verne.lose: I'll have to rewrite this chapter.

pasteur.select: I am fighting an enemy no eye can see.
pasteur.idle: Hmm, these tiny things spread disease.
pasteur.defend: I boiled and sterilized it already.
pasteur.skill: Bless you all. This vaccine will protect everyone.
pasteur.win: The child lived. That is enough.
pasteur.lose: We can always run the experiment again.

houdini.select: No lock in the world can hold me!
houdini.idle: Now, would you pick a card?
houdini.move: Ladies and gentlemen, to the stage!
houdini.attack: Blink and you'll miss it! Hup!
houdini.skill: Ta-da! The wound vanishes without a trace!
houdini.win: A round of applause, please! Thank you!
houdini.lose: Haha... that was just a rehearsal.

earhart.idle: It must be clear above the clouds today.
earhart.lose: Ran out of fuel. Next time I'll go farther.

twain.select: Want to hear a funny story?
twain.idle: The Mississippi will flow slowly again today.
twain.move: Shall we drift along on a raft?
twain.attack: The pen stings more than the sword!
twain.defend: Reports of my defeat are greatly exaggerated.
twain.skill: Well, let's start over from the beginning!
twain.win: Ha, this will make a good story.
twain.lose: Well, losing stories are fun to write too.

fabre.select: Look closely at the little things.
fabre.idle: Shh... a dung beetle is passing by.
fabre.attack: A bee's sting is small, but it smarts!
fabre.defend: Just curl up tight like a beetle.
fabre.skill: Hold tight. A shell doesn't break easily.
fabre.win: A good observation. I'll write it in my notebook.
fabre.lose: It's fine. We can look again tomorrow.

bangjeonghwan.select: Children are the hope of tomorrow.
bangjeonghwan.idle: What story shall I tell the children today?
bangjeonghwan.move: Let's hold hands and go together.
bangjeonghwan.attack: You must not make the children cry!
bangjeonghwan.skill: Everyone, cheer up! We can do it!
bangjeonghwan.win: Everyone's smiling, so I'm happy too.
bangjeonghwan.lose: It's okay. If you fall, just get back up.

enemy_gate.appear: Halt! No one passes this gate!

enemy_boss.appear: So you made it this far. But this is the end.
enemy_boss.win: You're not ready. Come back stronger!

enemy_keeper.appear: I guard this outpost. Come at me!

lubu.select: Thiên hạ này ai dám cản ta? Có gan thì bước ra đây.
lubu.idle: Hừ, tay chân ngứa ngáy quá. Bao giờ mới đánh?
lubu.attack: Đỡ lấy kích của ta! Hây!
lubu.defend: Ha ha! Chỉ có vậy thôi sao?
lubu.skill: Hãy nhìn đây! Sức mạnh vô song của ta!
lubu.win: Ha ha ha! Thiên hạ không ai địch nổi ta!
lubu.lose: Hự... Mối nhục này ta sẽ không quên.

yisunsin.select: Thần vẫn còn mười hai chiến thuyền.
yisunsin.idle: Trước hết phải xem gió và dòng nước.
yisunsin.attack: Ngay bây giờ! Bắn đồng loạt!
yisunsin.defend: Không được lùi. Giữ vững đội hình!
yisunsin.skill: Bày trận cánh hạc! Bao vây quân địch!
yisunsin.win: Đó là nhờ tất cả cùng chiến đấu.
yisunsin.lose: Quyết tử thì sẽ sống. Ta sẽ đứng dậy.

alexander.select: Ta sẽ tận mắt nhìn thấy tận cùng thế giới.
alexander.idle: Bên kia chân trời chắc cũng có những vương quốc.
alexander.attack: Hãy mở đường trước lưỡi kiếm của ta!
alexander.defend: Vua không bao giờ lùi bước!
alexander.skill: Chinh phục! Thế giới là của chúng ta!
alexander.win: Thêm một vùng đất sẽ nhớ tên ta.
alexander.lose: Giỏi lắm... Ta sẽ nhớ tên ngươi.

machao.select: Mã Siêu của Tây Lương xuất trận đây!
machao.idle: Ngựa của ta muốn phi. Ta cũng vậy.
machao.attack: Đỡ lấy ngọn giáo Tây Lương!
machao.defend: Chừng này thôi à? Ta đỡ được!
machao.skill: Không thoát được đâu! Đuổi theo đến cùng!
machao.win: Ha! Kỵ binh Tây Lương chiến thắng!
machao.lose: Chưa đâu... Vẫn chưa kết thúc!

eulji.select: Dòng sông này ta hiểu rõ hơn ai hết.
eulji.idle: Chờ địch mệt mỏi cũng là binh pháp.
eulji.move: Đã đến lúc. Chúng ta đi thôi.
eulji.attack: Thấy sơ hở rồi! Ngay bây giờ!
eulji.defend: Ta không lùi một bước nào.
eulji.skill: Trúng kế rồi! Phá đê đi!
eulji.win: Ha ha, biết đủ thì hãy quay về đi.
eulji.lose: Hừm, ta bị đọc vị mất rồi.

leonidas.select: Không ai được bước qua con đường này.
leonidas.idle: Lau sạch khiên đi. Sắp đến trận chiến rồi.
leonidas.attack: Đỡ lấy giáo của ta! Hây!
leonidas.skill: Không được lùi! Chúng ta là bức tường thành!
leonidas.lose: Dù ngã xuống... ta không buông khiên.

hanxin.select: Binh lính càng nhiều càng tốt.
hanxin.idle: Trận thắng đã được định trước khi bắt đầu.
hanxin.move: Từng bước một, theo thứ tự.
hanxin.attack: Ngay bây giờ! Dồn ép chúng!
hanxin.skill: Bày trận bối thủy! Không còn đường lùi!
hanxin.win: Mọi thứ đúng như kế sách.
hanxin.lose: Kế của ta còn nông cạn. Phải tính lại.

ganning.select: Nghe tiếng chuông không? Cam Ninh ta đến rồi!
ganning.idle: Chà, ngứa ngáy chịu không nổi!
ganning.defend: Thế mà gọi là tấn công à?
ganning.skill: Không nghỉ đâu! Tiếp chiêu nữa!
ganning.win: Ha ha ha! Tối nay rượu sẽ ngon lắm đây!
ganning.lose: Chậc, hôm nay chỉ xui thôi.

choiyoung.idle: Nước yên thì tướng mới được nghỉ.
choiyoung.skill: Dựng tường sắt! Không cho ai lọt qua!
choiyoung.win: Bá tánh đêm nay có thể ngủ yên rồi.

robinhood.select: Ta là Robin Hood, cung thủ giỏi nhất rừng Sherwood.
robinhood.idle: Hôm nay túi ai sẽ nặng đây nhỉ?
robinhood.move: Ta rành đường rừng này. Theo ta!
robinhood.skill: Ta mượn tạm cái này nhé. Phần của người nghèo!
robinhood.win: Trúng đích! Tối nay ăn mừng!
robinhood.lose: Ha ha... cũng có ngày tên bắn trượt.

mulan.select: Con sẽ thay cha ra trận.
mulan.idle: Ta sẽ lau kiếm và chờ thời cơ.
mulan.defend: Chừng này không quật ngã được ta!
mulan.skill: Dù bao nhiêu lần, ta cũng sẽ đứng dậy!
mulan.win: Làm được rồi! Mọi người đều an toàn chứ?
mulan.lose: Tức quá... nhưng lần sau ta nhất định thắng.

gyebaek.select: Không còn đường lui. Đây là chỗ của chúng ta.
gyebaek.idle: Gió trên cánh đồng lạnh quá.
gyebaek.defend: Chưa chết thì ta chưa lùi!
gyebaek.skill: Lùi lại! Đến gần là ta chém!
gyebaek.lose: Đến đây thôi sao... Ta đã chiến đấu không hổ thẹn.

sejong.select: Vì bá tánh, ta sẽ làm bất cứ điều gì.
sejong.idle: Đêm đã khuya. Đọc thêm chút nữa rồi ngủ.
sejong.attack: Điều sai trái phải được sửa lại!
sejong.skill: Hãy viết tiếng nói của bá tánh thành chữ!
sejong.win: Đó là nhờ trí tuệ của mọi người.
sejong.lose: Lẽ ra trẫm phải xem xét kỹ hơn.

zhugeliang.select: Ngọa Long đã tỉnh. Ngài có muốn nghe kế sách thiên hạ?
zhugeliang.idle: Các vì sao chuyển động bất thường.
zhugeliang.move: Gió đã đổi chiều. Đi thôi.
zhugeliang.attack: Ngươi đã nằm trong lòng bàn tay ta.
zhugeliang.defend: Nước đi đó ta đã đọc từ lâu.
zhugeliang.skill: Ta sẽ bày Bát Trận Đồ. Không có lối thoát.
zhugeliang.win: Mọi việc đều theo kế sách.

davinci.select: Thế giới đầy những điều thú vị.
davinci.idle: Chim bay thế nào nhỉ... Hừm, phải vẽ lại.
davinci.move: Nào, đi xem tận mắt thôi!
davinci.defend: Ta đã chuẩn bị sẵn rồi.
davinci.skill: Hãy xem bản thiết kế trong đầu ta!
davinci.win: Tuyệt vời! Chạy đúng như ta nghĩ!
